name: Aspect of Nerull

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Aura of Fear
traits.details: Enemies within the aura take a -2 penalty to attack rolls.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: The aspect of Nerull regains 15 hit points whenever it starts its turn and has at least 1 hit point. If the aspect of Nerull takes radiant damage, its regeneration doesn’t function until the end of its next turn.

auras.name: Aura of Fear
auras.details: Enemies within the aura take a -2 penalty to attack rolls.

hit.description: force and necrotic damage, and the target is slowed and weakened until the end of its next turn.

powers.name: Nerull’s Wrath
powers.requirements: The aspect must be wielding a death scythe.

effect.description: The aspect shifts 6 squares and can use death scythe twice at any points during that move. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is slowed and weakened (save ends).

powers.name: Halo of Pain
powers.requirements: The aspect must be wielding a death scythe.

hit.description: force and necrotic damage, and ongoing 10 damage (save ends).

effect.description: The triggering creature grants combat advantage (save ends).
